evidence_table.claim: Q3 total revenue was USD73.683bn, up 6%, while adjusted income from operations was USD2.104bn versus USD2.096bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Results-release consolidated highlights and adjusted results table.

evidence_table.claim: Evernorth adjusted revenue was USD63.774bn, adjusted pretax income USD1.829bn versus USD1.903bn, and margin 2.9% versus 3.2%.
Pharmacy Benefit Services revenue rose 9% to USD37.276bn while adjusted pretax income fell 22% to USD765m; simple margins were 765/37,276=2.05% and 975/34,091=2.86%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Evernorth component table; arithmetic independently recomputed.
evidence_table.result: verified; management explanation for renewals and investment labelled

evidence_table.claim: Specialty and Care Services adjusted income rose 15% and Cigna Healthcare adjusted income rose 15% with a 10.2% margin and 85.0% medical-care ratio.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Evernorth component and Cigna Healthcare segment tables.

evidence_table.claim: Accelerate to One targets USD3bn of savings/productivity, 10%-14% adjusted EPS CAGR and about USD50bn of operating cash through 2030; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance rose to at least USD30.60.
evidence_table.result: verified and labelled as management targets/guidance

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash flow was USD3.281bn, capex USD0.8bn, repurchases about USD0.5bn, and debt-to-capital 41.8%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Form 10-Q cash-flow, liquidity and capitalisation disclosures.
